title: Start here: your shared-tablet app
text:
01
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Start here: your shared-tablet app
1
Choose a workspace
Use Today for the daily queue. Overview adds
popular services and product brands. The
sidebar also opens Bookings, Customers,
Services & packages, Products, Invoices, and
Settings.
2
Use the quick actions
On Today, New customer starts a
customer-to-booking flow. New booking
opens an appointment for an existing
customer.
3
Follow the worked example
Taylor Sample has a Honda CR-V booked for a
$120 interior detail. We record a $40 deposit,
then an $80 final payment.
1
2
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Examples use September 30, 2026. Your dates, invoice numbers, names, and totals will differ. Records are local to this browser and device.

title: Set up your business
text:
02
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Set up your business
1
Open Settings
Enter Business name. Our fictional business is
Blue Bay Detailing.
2
Add invoice contact details
Fill Business phone, Business email, Business
address, and Invoice payment instructions.
Leave optional details blank if you do not need
them.
3
Save changes
Scroll if needed and select Save changes.
Open an invoice to check that your business
name and contact information appear.
1
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT / FOCUSED VIEW
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Expected result: your invoices and downloaded PDFs use these business details. The WZXU app branding stays in the app.

title: Match capacity to your crew
text:
03
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Match capacity to your crew
1
Find the capacity setting
In Settings, use Vehicles the crew can work on
at once. Choose from 1 to 5 vehicles.
2
Choose simultaneous vehicle capacity
The screenshot shows 2 vehicles selected as an
example. A five-person crew may still work on
only one vehicle at a time; choose the actual
vehicle capacity.
3
Save and schedule carefully
Select Save changes. Each booking reserves its
full service duration. If capacity is full, choose a
different time or change capacity.
1
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT / FOCUSED VIEW
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Guide default: 1 vehicle. A 90-minute booking at 08:30 reserves time until 10:00. Adjacent bookings can meet at 10:00 without overlapping.

title: Load the practice records
text:
04
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Load the practice records
1
Choose a practice date
In Settings, scroll to Sample data. Set Sample
booking date to the date you want to practice.
2
Load sample data
Select Load sample data once. It adds four
customers and bookings, plus one invoice per
sample service. It does not replace your other
records.
3
View samples
Select View samples or Today and choose the
same schedule date. Add sample invoices fills
any missing sample invoices without
duplicating existing ones.
2
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT / FOCUSED VIEW
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Expected result: one Completed, In progress, Confirmed, and Pending sample booking. The completed sample starts with a paid invoice; the other three start unpaid.

title: Read the Today dashboard
text:
05
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Read the Today dashboard
1
Set Schedule date
Choose the workday. The job list excludes
cancelled and removed bookings. Search the
list by customer, vehicle, or service.
2
Read the four totals
Jobs today counts that date's jobs. Jobs
remaining excludes completed jobs. Money
collected sums payments on the selected date.
3
Open a job
Details opens the booking; Invoice opens or
creates its invoice. Unpaid invoices shows all
outstanding invoice balances, across dates.
3
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Initial sample totals: 4 jobs, 3 remaining, $45 collected, and $750 outstanding. After Taylor's $40 deposit, collection becomes $85 and outstanding becomes $710.
WZXU.pro | Fictional training examples | Current app screenshots

title: Add a new customer
text:
06
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Add a new customer
1
Start from Today
Select New customer. Use Check existing
customers first to search names, vehicles, or
phone numbers and avoid a duplicate.
2
Enter customer details
Full name and Vehicle are required. Phone,
Email, and Care preferences & notes are
optional. Example: Alex Demo, Toyota Corolla,
555-0101.
3
Continue to the booking
Select Save & continue to booking. The
customer is saved and the New booking form
opens with Alex selected.
3
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT / FOCUSED VIEW
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Expected result: no need to re-enter the new customer. In the Customers workspace, Add customer saves a customer without automatically continuing to booking.
WZXU.pro | Fictional training examples | Current app screenshots

title: Book an existing customer
text:
07
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Book an existing customer
1
Open New booking
From Today or Bookings, select New booking.
Choose the correct Customer from the
dropdown.
2
Choose service and time
Choose Service package, Date, Time, and
Status. Example shown: Taylor Sample, Interior
detail, October 1 at 09:00, Confirmed.
3
Confirm the booking
Add appointment notes or condition
information if needed. Scroll down and select
Confirm booking. If capacity is full, adjust the
appointment time.
1
2
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT / FOCUSED VIEW
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Expected result: a saved appointment uses the package price and duration. The form shown is a new example; Taylor's September 30 sample job remains the main payment
example.

title: Edit, cancel, or remove bookings
text:
08
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Edit, cancel, or remove bookings
1
Find the appointment
Open Bookings and use search or Filter status.
Select Edit on the correct row to open Booking
details.
2
Make a change or cancel
Change the date, time, service, notes, or
Status. To cancel without removing the record,
choose Cancelled, then Save changes.
3
Remove a record when needed
Use Remove booking inside the dialog, or the
row's trash button. Select Undo immediately
to restore the last removed record.
2
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT / FOCUSED VIEW
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Example: Alex's 17:00 booking is set to Cancelled. It remains visible in Bookings but no longer appears in Today's active job queue. Removing a booking does not remove its
invoice.
WZXU.pro | Fictional training examples | Current app screenshots

title: Start work and complete a job
text:
09
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Start work and complete a job
1
Start the vehicle
On a Pending or Confirmed job, select Start
job. Its status changes to In progress. Example:
Morgan's full detail.
2
Finish the work
On an In progress job, select Complete job.
Example: complete Taylor's interior detail after
the work is finished.
3
Review its invoice
Select Invoice on the completed job. Check the
services, extras, and payment status before
handing it to the customer.
1
2
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Expected result: Taylor becomes Completed and Jobs remaining decreases. Completing a job does not mark its invoice paid or charge the customer.

title: Record condition notes and photos
text:
10
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Record condition notes and photos
1
Open the job details
Select Details for the vehicle. Scroll inside the
booking dialog to Vehicle condition.
2
Document existing condition
Enter scratches, dents, stains, or areas needing
care. Use Condition photos (up to 4) to choose
JPEG, PNG, or WebP photos under 15 MB
each.
3
Save the evidence
Wait for photo preparation to finish, then
select Save changes. Reopen Details to check
the notes and any photo thumbnails. Remove
photo removes a selected attachment.
1
2
3
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT / FOCUSED VIEW
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Example note: small scratch on rear bumper and light coffee stain on passenger seat. No vehicle photo is attached in this screenshot. Photos are compressed and included in
backups.

title: Maintain customer information
text:
11
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Maintain customer information
1
Open a customer
Go to Customers, search if needed, then select
the customer row. Taylor's Honda CR-V is
shown.
2
Update details and preferences
Edit the name, vehicle, contact details, or care
notes and select Save customer. Service
history lists that customer's active bookings
and their statuses.
3
Book again or remove
Book appointment opens a booking with this
customer selected. Remove customer removes
the customer from the active list; use Undo
immediately if it was a mistake.
3
3
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT / FOCUSED VIEW
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Expected result: Taylor's history shows the September 30 Interior detail as Completed. Removing a customer does not automatically remove their bookings or invoices.

title: Manage your service packages
text:
12
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Manage your service packages
1
Review packages
Open Services & packages. Each card shows
the price, duration, description, and Products
used.
2
Edit or remove a package
Select Edit on the relevant card, update its
fields, and Save package. Remove hides a
package from the active catalog; Undo
restores the last removed record.
3
Book directly from a card
Select Book this service to open a booking
with that package selected. Existing booking
prices and durations remain as recorded.
1
2
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Example: Interior detail costs $120 and takes 90 minutes. Product notes are catalog information, not inventory tracking or a purchase order.

title: Add a service package
text:
13
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Add a service package
1
Select Add package
In Services & packages, choose Add package.
Use a distinct Package name; duplicate names
are rejected.
2
Enter the package details
Example: Upholstery refresh, Price $60,
Duration 45 minutes. Add a description and
Products used, such as Koch-Chemie Pol Star.
3
Save package
Select Save package. The package appears in
the catalog and in new booking service
choices. Duration is entered in five-minute
steps, with a five-minute minimum.
3
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT / FOCUSED VIEW
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Expected result: the new package is available to book. Removing or editing a package does not recalculate a previously saved booking's amount.
WZXU.pro | Fictional training examples | Current app screenshots

title: Add and maintain products
text:
14
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Add and maintain products
1
Open the product form
Go to Products and select Add product. To
change an existing item, use its Edit button
instead.
2
Fill the fields
Product name and Brand are required. Add
Category and choose Used with, or No specific
package. Example: Seat cleaner / Demo Brand
/ Upholstery care / Upholstery refresh.
3
Save or remove
Select Save product. On the product list,
Remove hides an item; Undo restores the last
removed item. Use unique product names.
3
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT / FOCUSED VIEW
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Expected result: a product entry linked to the chosen package. This list records your product lineup; it does not count stock or automatically edit the package's Products
used text.

title: Create or open an invoice
text:
15
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Create or open an invoice
1
Open the booking invoice
From Today use Invoice, or from Bookings use
the row's Invoice button. Booking details also
includes Create invoice.
2
Review the customer and service
If an active invoice already exists for that
booking, it opens. Otherwise the app creates
one from the booking and customer
information.
3
Check before sharing
Confirm the business details, vehicle, service,
total, and payment status. Edit invoice changes
amounts; Print / Save PDF downloads the
invoice.
2
3
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT / FOCUSED VIEW
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Example: Invoice 0002 for Taylor Sample's Honda CR-V, Interior detail, $120 unpaid. Samples already include invoices; the same button opens their saved invoice.

title: Add extras and a discount
text:
16
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Add extras and a discount
1
Select Edit invoice
Review Service price ($). Add extra service
creates a line with an Extra service name and
Amount ($).
2
Apply the example amounts
Keep the service price at $120. Add Odor
treatment for $25 and enter a $25 Discount.
Choose the payment method if needed.
3
Save invoice
Check the displayed total before selecting
Save invoice. Remove extra service deletes an
extra line. Cancel editing discards unsaved
changes.
2
2
3
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT / FOCUSED VIEW / SCROLLED
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Worked calculation: $120 service + $25 extra - $25 discount = $120 total. Keeping this total makes the later $40 deposit / $80 balance example consistent.

title: Record a $40 deposit
text:
17
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Record a $40 deposit
1
Open the payment form
In the invoice, select Record deposit /
payment. This option appears while a balance
remains.
2
Record money actually received
Enter Payment amount ($) = 40, the actual
Payment date, and Payment method = Cash in
this example. The amount must be positive
and no greater than the balance.
3
Save payment
Select Save payment. Review the resulting
ledger and balance. This is a record of money
collected; the app does not charge the
customer.
2
3
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT / FOCUSED VIEW / SCROLLED
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Expected result: Taylor's $120 invoice now has a $40 payment. Its status changes to Part paid and the remaining balance is $80.
WZXU.pro | Fictional training examples | Current app screenshots
17 / 26

title: Check the remaining balance
text:
18
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Check the remaining balance
1
Read the three money figures
Total is $120. Payments received is $40.
Balance due is $80. The ledger also shows the
date, method, and amount of the deposit.
2
Check the daily totals
Close the invoice and return to Today for the
payment date. The example shows $85
collected: Jordan's $45 plus Taylor's $40
deposit.
3
Correct mistakes carefully
Remove payment removes that ledger entry
and recalculates the balance. It does not
refund a customer. Record deposit / payment
lets you enter another payment.
3
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT / FOCUSED VIEW / SCROLLED
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Outstanding balances are $710 in this demo: Taylor $80, Morgan $180, Casey $450. Payment date, rather than booking date, determines daily money collected.
WZXU.pro | Fictional training examples | Current app screenshots

title: Record the final $80 payment
text:
19
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Record the final $80 payment
1
Record the remaining payment
When Taylor pays the rest, select Record
deposit / payment again. Enter $80, the actual
date, and the method used.
2
Save and check the ledger
Select Save payment. The ledger now contains
$40 and $80, Payments received is $120, and
Balance due is $0.
3
Understand the quick status buttons
Mark paid records the entire remaining
balance as received today. Mark unpaid clears
the recorded payments. Use individual
payment entries when dates or methods
matter.
3
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT / FOCUSED VIEW / SCROLLED
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Expected result: the invoice is Paid. No funds are transferred by this app. Use the detailed payment form for deposits and split payments.
WZXU.pro | Fictional training examples | Current app screenshots

title: Download and print the invoice
text:
20
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Download and print the invoice
1
Select Print / Save PDF
Open the invoice and select Print / Save PDF.
The app downloads a file such as
Invoice-0002.pdf; it does not directly open a
browser print dialog.
2
Open the downloaded file
Use your device's Downloads folder or
download notification. Open the PDF, then use
the PDF viewer's Print command and choose
your printer.
3
Check the exported information
The example PDF was downloaded after the
$40 deposit: total $120, payments $40,
balance $80. It includes your business contact
details and payment instructions.
ACTUAL EXPORTED INVOICE PDF
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Actual exported PDF shown. The printed timestamp is at top right; Page X of Y is bottom left; a small WZXU Car Detailing App footer is bottom right.

title: Remove an invoice and use Undo
text:
21
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Remove an invoice and use Undo
1
Remove the correct invoice
Open an invoice from Invoices or its booking
and select Remove invoice. This removes it
from the active invoice list and dashboard
money totals.
2
Restore immediately if needed
The Last record removed bar appears. Select
Undo to restore that invoice. Undo applies
only to the most recent individually removed
record.
3
Understand what stays
The booking and customer stay in the app. If
you open Invoice on that booking after
removal, the app can create a new invoice with
a new number.
2
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Example shown after removing Taylor's partially paid invoice: collection temporarily drops from $85 to $45. Undo restores the invoice, its ledger, and the original totals.
WZXU.pro | Fictional training examples | Current app screenshots

title: Download a daily backup
text:
22
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Download a daily backup
1
Open Settings and scroll down
Find Backup & restore. The app shows Last
backup downloaded and reminds you when
no backup has been downloaded today.
2
Download WZXU CDA backup
Select the button. Save the JSON file
somewhere you can find it. Example filename:
WZXU-CDA-backup-2026-09-30.json.
3
Keep a separate safe copy
At the end of the working day, keep the
downloaded file outside the browser. Backups
include business settings, customers,
bookings, catalogs, invoices, payments, and
attached photos.
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT / FOCUSED VIEW
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Expected result: Last backup downloaded updates to today. This is a download reminder, not automatic cloud backup or confirmation that the file was copied elsewhere.
WZXU.pro | Fictional training examples | Current app screenshots
22 / 26

title: Restore records from a backup
text:
23
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Restore records from a backup
1
Choose backup to restore
In Settings, select Choose backup to restore
and choose the saved WZXU JSON file. Invalid
or oversized files are rejected.
2
Review the preview
Ready to restore shows the customer,
booking, and invoice counts. Our demo has 5
customers, 5 bookings, and 4 invoices. Cancel
closes the preview without restoring.
3
Restore these records
Select Restore these records only when this is
the intended backup. It replaces the app
records on this device and downloads a
backup of the previous records first.
3
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT / FOCUSED VIEW
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Expected result: the saved dataset returns, including payments and condition photos. Check your browser's download completed before relying on the pre-restore backup.
WZXU.pro | Fictional training examples | Current app screenshots

title: Remove the practice samples
text:
24
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Remove the practice samples
1
Open Sample data in Settings
When samples are loaded, select Remove
samples to clear the practice records.
2
Check the cleanup
Sample customers, sample bookings, and all
invoices linked to sample bookings are
removed from the active lists. Your other
records remain.
3
Load another practice set if wanted
Once no active sample bookings remain, Load
sample data becomes available again. Choose
the new practice date before loading.
1
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT / FOCUSED VIEW
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Expected result in our isolated demo: Invoices becomes empty because all four invoices belonged to samples. The separately added Alex customer and custom catalog
entries remain. Sample removal has no Undo button; use a backup to restore it.

title: Factory reset: start fresh
text:
25
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Factory reset: start fresh
1
Back up first
In Settings, download a backup before using
Factory reset if you need to keep any records.
2
Review the confirmation
Select Factory reset. The dialog explains that
customers, bookings, invoices, samples, and
custom catalog entries will be cleared. Type
RESET only when you intend to erase them.
3
Reset or cancel
Reset everything becomes available after
RESET is typed. Cancel closes the dialog. The
guide shows the confirmation only; no factory
reset was executed.
2
3
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT / FOCUSED VIEW
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
Factory reset cannot be undone. Business name and crew capacity return to defaults, with the starter service and product catalogs. Customers, bookings, and invoices start
empty.
WZXU.pro | Fictional training examples | Current app screenshots

title: Install on a tablet and work offline
text:
26
WZXU CDA / USER GUIDE
Install on a tablet and work offline
1
Use the production app online first
Open the production version and wait for
Tablet & offline access to show Ready for
offline use on this device. The development
preview is not the offline installation build.
2
Add the app to the tablet
Use the browser's Install app or Add to Home
Screen command. On iPad, use Safari's Share
menu. An Install WZXU CDA button appears
when the browser offers installation.
3
Keep one shared device and back up
The cached production app can reopen offline
after setup. Customers, photos, invoices, and
payments stay in this browser/device. Other
devices do not automatically share records.
ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT / FOCUSED VIEW
RESULT / IMPORTANT DETAIL
For daily use: check Today, update jobs, record actual payments, then download a backup. Offline access is not cloud synchronization or a second copy of your business
records.
